ring_outline_1104._why: NEAR6-MS (4 Nov 2026), F39#23 P2-114 catch-chance HUD contrast (board 5.65). With the readout plated and outlined, the aim ring itself is the weak read: thin coloured arcs with no outline vanish against pale Tidewake sand and pale creatures. When enabled, capture_reticle.gd draws a dark UITokens.OUTLINE arc under each ring arc and the inner chance arc, and thickens the arcs by width_scale. Presentation only. OFF until judged.

contrast_r2._why: Visual lane (3 Nov 2026), P2-114 / F39#23 (CPU v1/ui1b 5.34; all three judges: 'CAPTURE CHANCE caption tiny and pale', 'orange percentage on pale shell and sand with only a faint plate'). On: caption 26 -> 32 px in TEXT_PRIMARY (was TEXT_SECONDARY) and the plate near-opaque (0.85 -> 0.96). Presentation only (capture_reticle.gd). OFF until judged; judged together with readout_side_enabled. CPU v1/b5 (3 Nov 2026; three code-blind judges, anchors, linear slope 1.57, r 0.90, RMSE 0.50, confirming batch): F39#23 Tidewake catch frames 6.02 -> 6.91 mapped with readout_side_enabled + contrast_r2, ON.

_why_side_on: CPU v1/b5 (3 Nov 2026; three code-blind judges, anchors, linear slope 1.57, r 0.90, RMSE 0.50, confirming batch): with contrast_r2, F39#23 6.02 -> 6.91 mapped; ON.
_why_side: P2-058/P2-114 (GPU UI-1, 31 Oct: P2-114 6.12, P2-058 6.24 with the plate; judges: keep the plate, move the readout off the target). When on, the percentage and caption sit beside the ring instead of under it, on the target body (capture_reticle.gd side_readout_positions), and the number grows by side_number_px_bonus. UIPOSES lane candidate; OFF until GPU judging.
_comment: P2-114 production capture-readout outline, default on under the owner's Phase 1 instruction. Uses UITokens.OUTLINE behind the percentage and caption and follows each text's alpha. Logical UI pixel tuning; no save, network, target, camera or catch-chance effect. Phase 2 visual acceptance remains required.
_why_backing: P2-114 GPU item score 5.37 (28 Oct): with the outline on, the capture-chance readout still read dark, unbacked and lost against pale sand and the creatures. When on, one rounded BG_PANEL plate (UITokens.RADIUS corners) sits behind the percentage and caption, following the readout's alpha (capture_reticle.gd `_draw_readout_backing`). Candidate: OFF until the GPU UI arm passes.
